interpretation.plain_speak: Age counters alone only predict 36 of 64 evictions. Together with the earlier hand-only ablation, we now know neither piece works by itself: the exact warning state is the replacement hand plus the age vector.
interpretation.north_star_question: Pins the minimal demonstrated architecture-native state for exact one-step replacement forecasting under refresh.
interpretation.next_stage: use the frozen hand-plus-age forecast before mixed writes to predict whether an original durable item will be lost, testing an explicit prewrite loss warning without changing memory behavior
